messages.content: amar content niche decide korte problem hocche, onek options mathay ase
Ki ki options ache mathay, ektu list koro dekhi।
lifestyle, fitness, ar personal storytelling - kono ekta e pick korte hobe?
Ekta e pick korte hobe emon rule nai, but shuru te focus thakle audience clear thake. Ei tinta te kon ta te tumi sobcheye comfortable ar consistent thakte parba, seta ta priority dao.
mone hoy personal storytelling e sobcheye comfortable
Tahole oita diye shuru koro - baki duita pore integrate korte paro jokhon nijer voice ta strong hoye jabe. Shuru ta perfect hote hobe emon na, just shuru kora important.
